It uses Google Drive as the entry point, then routes work to Docs, Sheets, or Slides for in-place updates, consolidation, restructuring, import repair, and decision-ready summaries. Developers reach for google-workspace-ops when locating shared plans or customer lists in Drive, cleaning messy spreadsheets, reformatting slide decks, or producing summaries from living documents and trackers. The skill also covers Sheets automation and Gmail integration per its manifest. It fits teams whose operational truth lives in Google Workspace instead of a dedicated project database.
highlights: Unified entry via Google Drive search before switching to Docs, Sheets, or Slides
Always inspect and summarize structure before any edit or migration
Handles find, update-in-place, consolidate, clean, import, repair, reformat, and produce summaries
Works across plans, trackers, customer lists, decks, and shared documents as living systems
